attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file PA Corporate Net Income Tax return. PA has $500,000 economic nexus threshold (higher than typical $100K).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in PA (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "PA" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "PA" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - PA CNIT filing required
action_details.action_dsl: add "PA CNIT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: PA Code Title 72 7401(3)2.(a)(15)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "PA CNIT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: PA Code Title 72 7401(3)2.(a)(15)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - PA CNIT filing required; PA filing required due to economic nexus ($500K threshold)
action_details.action_dsl: add "PA CNIT filing required due to economic nexus. PA threshold: $500,000 (higher than typical $100K). Reference: PA Code Title 72 7401(3)2.(a)(15)(C)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "PA CNIT filing required due to economic nexus. PA threshold: $500,000 (higher than typical $100K). Reference: PA Code Title 72 7401(3)2.(a)(15)(C)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no PA filing required; No PA nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No PA nexus - no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No PA nexus - no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate PA state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate PA adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate PA state additions and subtractions; Calculate PA-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "PA income adjustments calculated. Additions: Federal interest, IRC 199A addback, state taxes. Subtractions: PA municipal interest, dividends (100% DRD), PA NOL. Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(b)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "PA income adjustments calculated. Additions: Federal interest, IRC 199A addback, state taxes. Subtractions: PA municipal interest, dividends (100% DRD), PA NOL. Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(b)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no PA state adjustments; No PA nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "No PA nexus - no adjustments calculated." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No PA nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate PA Corporate Net Income Tax (CNIT). Applies PA 8.99% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe PA tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate PA tax (8.99% flat rate); PA CNIT at 8.99% flat rate (one of highest state corporate rates)
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "PA CNIT calculated at 8.99% flat rate (one of highest state corporate rates). Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(a)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax - cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "PA CNIT calculated at 8.99% flat rate (one of highest state corporate rates). Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(a)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No PA nexus - no tax liability; No PA nexus - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No PA nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No PA nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No PA taxable income (loss year); No PA taxable income - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No PA taxable income - no tax. PA NOL may be carried forward indefinitely (80% limitation). Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(b)(2)(B)(III)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No PA taxable income - no tax. PA NOL may be carried forward indefinitely (80% limitation). Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(b)(2)(B)(III)" job.audit_trail swap addto
